assets.name: hero-v2
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: portrait 4:5 ecommerce workout-wear campaign photograph. Primary request: a dynamic, gritty, high-fashion streetwear sports editorial, two young adult athletes moving confidently down broad brutalist concrete steps in a real urban plaza. Subject: stylish athletic woman with dark ponytail in a washed charcoal oversized workout tee and black cycling shorts in the foreground, and an athletic Black man in a muted sage-green boxy sports tee and black nylon shorts slightly behind to the right. Both wear white ribbed crew socks and off-white trainers. Capture an energetic mid-stride moment with one shoe lifted toward camera, shot from a low angle on a wide lens, powerful diagonal body lines, natural athletic movement, believable anatomy and real textured skin. Full bodies visible, generous composition around all faces and feet, no bodies cut at frame edges. Urban pale concrete architecture, a concrete stair railing and blue sky. Direct late-afternoon sunlight, hard graphic shadows, slightly flash-lit analog 35mm fashion photography, subtle film grain, authentic candid expression and rich realistic fabric texture. Composition: portrait, two athletes fill most of the vertical photo, dramatic foreground perspective and dynamic movement, editorial still, no graphics or text. Palette: warm concrete gray, washed charcoal, muted sage, white, sky blue. Avoid logos, writing, watermarks, collage, extra limbs, cartoon rendering, floating clothing, surreal anatomy. This will be used on the right half of a bold lime-colored streetwear ecommerce homepage hero.
